name: @pipedog/audio-ten-vad
description: TEN VAD (TenVADAnalyzer) for pipedog: an opt-in alternative to Silero that drives TEN VAD's WebAssembly build, which you obtain from TEN and pass in. Ships none of TEN's code or model.

needs.all: TEN VAD's WebAssembly build (ten_vad.js and ten_vad.wasm from TEN's lib/Web), obtained from TEN under TEN's license and passed in at runtime. pipedog ships none of it.
needs.workerd: Import ten_vad.wasm as a module and pass it as wasmModule (Workers can't compile WebAssembly from bytes).
